title: dsd health output
description: JSON output schema for `dsd health --json`. This is the frozen platform API surface for the 2.x series (see COMPATIBILITY.md). Generated from the JSONOutput struct in internal/render/json.go; the struct is the source of truth and internal/render/schema_sync_test.go fails if the two drift.

hostname.description: Hostname of the machine that ran the check

os.description: Pretty OS name of the machine that ran the check (e.g. "Ubuntu 24.04 LTS")

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp when the check ran

verdict.description: Overall verdict: the worst insight level. Mirrors the process exit code (OK->0, WARN->1, CRIT->2).

counts.description: Insight tallies by level, so a consumer can branch without iterating .insights

errored.description: Number of checks[] entries with status "ERROR" (the collector itself failed to run) — distinct from the CRIT/WARN/INFO insight tallies above, since a failed collector typically produces only an INFO-level insight and never raises verdict/warn/crit on its own

unverified.description: Number of insights with unverified=true — a check that ran without error but could not determine the specific thing it checks (permission denied, an unreadable file, a read that failed). Distinct from errored: the collector succeeded, one measurement inside it didn't. Its level is usually a downgraded INFO, which (like errored) never raises verdict/warn/crit on its own — see the verdict field's own description.

checks.description: One entry per collector that ran. A collector not applicable to the host is omitted, not shown as OK.

status.description: Outcome of the collector run. Rolled up from the worst insight for that collector (including subsystem-qualified insights). ERROR means the collector itself failed to run.

inline.description: Pre-rendered human-readable drill-down text. NOT part of the stable contract; presence and content may change freely (see COMPATIBILITY.md).

duration.description: Wall-clock time taken by the collector (e.g. 1.2ms)

error.description: Error message if status is ERROR

raw.description: The collector's full internal model, serialized as-is. INTENTIONALLY UNCONSTRAINED and explicitly out-of-contract: its fields may be added, renamed, retyped, or removed in any release with no notice. Do not build consumers against raw.* (see COMPATIBILITY.md).

insights.description: Actionable findings produced by analysis. OK-level insights are not emitted.

check.description: Which collector or sub-check produced this insight. May be a bare collector name (CPU) or subsystem-qualified (CPU/Steal, Network/DNS, Disk /var); consumers matching on collector should match by prefix, not equality.

message.description: Human-readable description of the finding. Presence is stable; exact text is not — do not parse it.

hints.description: Suggested commands or actions to investigate

unverified.description: True when level reflects a downgrade because the underlying data could NOT be read/measured this run (permission denied, an unreadable file, a collector error) — not a genuine 'nothing wrong here' finding. Consumers that diff two runs must not treat a transition into or out of an unverified insight as an improvement.

details.description: Structured drill-down for the insight. Stable envelope: type, title, columns, rows, kv, note.

type.description: Discriminator for the details payload shape
